design_philosophy: A high-contrast, data-dense 'Control Room' aesthetic designed for a local event environment. The UI clearly delineates between the fluid, user-focused chat interface and the rigid, metrics-heavy admin backoffice. Content privacy is physically represented through 'metadata-only' visual locks and stark color coding.

typography.admin_badge: font-mono text-xs tracking-widest uppercase text-amber-500 bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20 px-2 py-1 inline-flex items-center gap-1

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Strict structural layout reflecting a system terminal rather than a consumer social app.
spacing_and_layout.gap_system: gap-4 for related items, gap-8 for distinct sections
spacing_and_layout.admin_layout: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-[250px_1fr] lg:grid-cols-[280px_1fr] h-screen overflow-hidden gap-0 border-collapse

chat_bubbles.user: bg-cyan-500/10 border border-cyan-500/20 text-zinc-100 rounded-r-xl rounded-tl-xl rounded-bl-sm p-4
chat_bubbles.other: bg-zinc-800/50 border border-zinc-700 text-zinc-300 rounded-l-xl rounded-tr-xl rounded-br-sm p-4

surface_styles.inputs: bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700 focus:border-cyan-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-cyan-500 rounded-sm transition-all text-zinc-100
surface_styles.badges: border border-zinc-700 bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-300 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono rounded-sm

buttons.primary: bg-cyan-500 hover:bg-cyan-400 text-zinc-950 font-medium rounded-sm px-6 py-2 transition-colors
buttons.destructive: bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/20 hover:bg-red-500 hover:text-white text-red-500 rounded-sm px-4 py-2 transition-colors
buttons.outline: border border-zinc-700 hover:border-zinc-500 text-zinc-300 px-4 py-2 rounded-sm transition-colors

components.forms: Use Shadcn customized components. Sharp edges (rounded-sm or rounded-none). No inner shadows.
components.tables: Use Shadcn Table. Strict grid lines (`border-collapse`). border-b border-zinc-800 on rows, hover:bg-zinc-900/50. Text should be heavily weighted towards mono-font for numbers, IDs, and timestamps.
components.modals: Shadcn Dialog. bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800. Glassmorphism backdrop (backdrop-blur-sm bg-black/60).

motion.philosophy: Instant and structural. No bouncy spring animations. Fade-ins and snappy transitions.
motion.chat_entrance: opacity-0 translate-y-2 to opacity-100 translate-y-0 duration-200

icons.style: Technical, minimal strokes (1.5px weight). Avoid filled icons unless active.
icons.install_command: Already installed in Shadcn projects, fallback: npm i lucide-react

login_background.description: Server room featuring network equipment with blue illumination. Ideal for tech theme.
login_background.usage: Use as a full-screen background with a heavy dark overlay (bg-zinc-950/85) behind the login card.

event_empty_state.description: Dark crowd silhouette at an event with stage lights.
event_empty_state.usage: Use for empty states in group chats or when no chat is selected (apply grayscale and opacity-10 filter).

accessibility.contrast: APCA compliant. Text on buttons minimum 4.5:1. Never use gray-on-gray for essential info.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid='login-submit-button'`, `data-testid='chat-message-input'`).

specific_instructions_for_main_agent: Tech Stack constraint: Generate React components using JavaScript (.jsx/.js files), not TypeScript.
Dual-Mode Strategy: Use distinct layouts for user vs admin. The Admin Dashboard MUST look like a 'Control Room' - heavy use of data tables, mono fonts, and grid lines.
Admin Privacy Requirement: Admins cannot read chats. Replace message bodies in the moderation/admin view with `[NUR METADATEN]`.
Localization: All hardcoded UI text MUST be in German (e.g., 'Nachricht senden', 'Nutzerverwaltung', 'Abmelden', 'Chat ausblenden').
Chat Polling: Since HTTP-Polling is requested, ensure the UI reflects 'Synchronisieren...' subtly, perhaps an indicator dot that pulses cyan when fetching.
Testing: Add data-testid attributes universally to interactive elements to prevent test failures during UI refactoring.
No default Vercel/Stripe generic look. Strictly enforce the JetBlack/Cyan 'Terminal' high-contrast aesthetic.
